themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to housing, social services, and public benefits. This theme reflects a shared rhetorical and legislative strategy to appeal to nationalist sentiments and address voter concerns over immigration and resource allocation.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia and Castilla y León for social aid and public services, excluding non-citizens.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes housing and welfare policies favoring French citizens, including a 'migrant labour levy' on foreign hires.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for residency-based restrictions on social benefits and public housing, targeting immigrants.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushes for stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Norwegian citizens in welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes banning foreign nationals from social housing and imposing a 'migrant labour levy' on employers hiring foreign workers.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The announcement of a preliminary U.S.-Iran peace agreement has triggered intense cross-national reactions from far-right and right-wing parties. Leaders are positioning themselves in relation to the deal, with some praising it as a diplomatic victory and others criticizing it as insufficient or dangerous.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
